newsitem.title: USA: Borg-Warner Security to merge armored unit.
newsitem.headline: Borg-Warner Security to merge armored unit.

text.p: Borg-Warner Security Corp said on Wednesday it signed a definitive agreement with (Wingate Partners) of Dallas to combine its Wells Fargo Armored unit with Wingate's Loomis Armored division.

The new independent company will be 49-percent owned by Borg-Warner Security and 51-percent owned by Loomis shareholders, Borg-Warner Security said. It will provide armored transportation, automated teller machine services and cash vault services nationwide, the companies said.
The deal is expected to close by the end of January, Borg-Warner Security said.
Borg-Warner Security is a provider of security services.
